blocks.text: CyberChef (gchq.github.io/CyberChef) is the swiss army knife. Common recipes:
`` From Base64 → From Hex → ROT13 # multi-layer encoding From Base64 → AES Decrypt (mode CBC) # encrypted blob with key in prompt Magic operation # auto-detect (often works!) ``
